data.title: Cloudflare’s Pivotal Role in AI-Driven Internet Supports Long-Term Growth Outlook and Unchanged $330 Buy Target
data.description:
Analyst Shrenik Kothari from Robert W. Baird maintained a Buy rating on Cloudflare and keeping the price target at $330.00.

Shrenik Kothari has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Cloudflare’s evolving role in the internet and AI ecosystem. He sees the company’s platform maturing into an operational layer that supports both the infrastructure developers need for AI applications and agents, and the control systems required by web owners to govern and monetize those agents, with several new products already carrying clear usage-based pricing and near-term monetization paths.

He also highlights that agent-driven traffic is becoming a major share of overall internet activity, and Cloudflare’s position in the request path enables it to distinguish, manage and eventually charge for different types of agent interactions based on their economic value. Together with the broader set of consumption vectors beyond simple traffic or inference, this underpins a favorable long-term growth outlook, supporting his unchanged $330 price target and Buy recommendation on the stock.

data.title: Alight Maintained at Buy as Abett Acquisition Strengthens Data Capabilities; $22 Price Target Reaffirmed
data.description:
Alight, the Technology sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst today. Analyst Peter Heckmann from D.A. Davidson maintained a Buy rating on the stock and has a $22.00 price target.

Peter Heckmann has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Alight’s strategic acquisition of Abett. He sees the deal as significantly strengthening Alight’s ability to securely aggregate and interpret vast amounts of healthcare and benefits data, improving decision-making for both employers and employees while supporting the company’s long-term value proposition.

Heckmann also notes that integrating Abett’s data engine into Alight’s large existing client base enhances benefits intelligence, employee engagement, and cost optimization across millions of covered lives. Although Abett’s near-term revenue impact appears modest and the purchase price relatively small, he believes the transaction meaningfully improves Alight’s competitive positioning, justifying the maintained Buy rating and unchanged $22 price target.

data.title: Oklo Earns Buy Rating on Successful Groves-1 Execution and Upside from Emerging Medical Isotope Business
data.description:
William Blair analyst Jed Dorsheimer has maintained their bullish stance on OKLO stock, giving a Buy rating yesterday.

Jed Dorsheimer has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including Oklo’s demonstrated execution at the Groves-1 site. The company moved from fuel selection to achieving criticality on privately owned land in roughly 11 months, showcasing a construction approach that can be replicated and refined for Groves-2 and, more importantly, the Aurora project at INL.

Jed Dorsheimer’s rating is based on Oklo’s ability to leverage lessons from Groves-1 to reduce execution risk for Aurora while also building a potentially significant radioisotope business. With a large, mostly unmet U.S. market for medical isotopes and Oklo’s plan to vertically integrate production using its flexible VIPR reactor, he sees meaningful upside beyond the core energy platform, supporting the Buy recommendation.
